rules: Every runtime module has exactly one bounded-context owner.
Domain/application code cannot depend on DOM, browser storage, network, wall clock, or ambient RNG.
Domain compatibility globals are explicitly allowlisted.
ECS component payloads are behavior-free plain data.
Imported JSON cannot register executable systems, commands, callbacks, modules, or source code.
Bundled 3D assets are immutable data manifests; model geometry and rig sockets do not live in renderer branches.

verification.rule: The current branch is considered verified only when gate-results.json is freshly produced for the current PR head and reports status=passed.

github.note: The verified implementation head above passed the complete TypeScript/architecture/asset/domain/schema/release/browser gate. Later documentation-only commits do not change runtime behavior.

deliberateDebt: Four large compatibility adapters remain and should be decomposed incrementally behind parity fixtures.
Strict semantic TypeScript checking is concentrated at architecture-critical seams; compatibility modules are migrated slice by slice.
The global LW facade and process-global registries remain compatibility surfaces for the self-contained browser artifact.
Generic ECS structural changes are atomic, while domain value transactions retain explicit preflight/rollback responsibility.
3D assets are build-time bundled and data-driven, but external scenario packs cannot yet import or replace asset manifests; that requires a separately designed trust/versioning policy.
limits: Hardware WebGL/GPU behavior is not verified by headless browser tests.
Physical touch devices, screen readers, localization, human usability, balance, and enjoyment require separate validation.
Native Motorsport Manager Godot gameplay is outside the Littlewild implementation scope, though repository CI may still run native regression gates.
